title: Portable Lesson Exchange
description: A sanitized, portable lesson record for exchanging reusable learning across repositories without private code, secrets, raw logs, or unnecessary personal data.

lesson_id.description: Stable, non-secret lesson identifier unique within the source repository or export batch.

source_repo.description: Sanitized source repository identifier. Use a public repo name, organization-neutral alias, or placeholder; do not include private URLs or internal hostnames.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 date-time when the lesson was captured or exported.

area.description: Subsystem, workflow, language, framework, or feature area where the lesson applies.

severity.description: Impact level of the original failure or review finding.

root_cause.description: Reusable root-cause pattern stated without blame, private implementation details, raw logs, secrets, or customer data.

fix_pattern.description: Generalized fix pattern that another repository can adapt safely.

prevention_rule.description: Checklist item, test expectation, prompt instruction, quality gate, or workflow guard that prevents recurrence.

tags.description: Search and filtering tags. Tags must not encode secrets, private repo names, customer names, or internal hostnames.

privacy_level.description: Sharing classification after privacy review. public is safe to publish; internal is safe only inside the organization; restricted requires explicit maintainer approval; private must not be exported outside the source repo.
